description: This file contains Playwright test specifications with various test modifiers such as skip, fixes, fail, and describe configurations, along with test execution and reporting logic for testing the modifiers and their behaviors within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: Reporter
classes.description: Custom reporter class that logs test execution events such as test start and end, along with their expected status, timeout, retries, for debugging and reporting purposes.

methods.name: expectTestHelper
methods.description: Helper function to facilitate assertions on test results by verifying individual test case properties such as status, annotations, and expected results.

methods.name: runInlineTest
methods.description: Executes inline test configurations and source files, simulating test runs within the framework, and returns a structured result object containing test outcomes, report data, and output logs.

methods.name: runTSC
methods.description: Runs TypeScript compilation checks on source files to verify type correctness and TypeScript-specific constraints, ensuring type safety in test setups.

ctags.name: expectTest
ctags.pattern: /^  const expectTest = (title: string, expectedStatus: string, status: string, annotations: any) =/
